action: Give each AI agent its own identity with least privilege and keep logs that can show afterwards what it did, as the article advises.
date_note: Article input date 18 November 2026; the report's own release date was not read.
exec: Firms letting AI agents change cloud systems may be unable to audit those changes.
plain: A Palo Alto Networks survey, as reported by Dailysecu, finds many firms cannot trace what their AI agents did in cloud systems.
summary: Dailysecu reports on Palo Alto Networks' State of Cloud Security Report 2026, a survey of 2,800 executives and practitioners in 10 countries. It says 40% cannot reconstruct afterwards what an AI agent did, and the average time from finding an issue to deploying the fix was 18.4 days. The figures are global, not Korea-specific.
title: Palo Alto Networks survey: 40% cannot reconstruct what an AI agent did

validation.note: Only Dailysecu's report of the survey was read; the Palo Alto report itself was not.
